content:
The **North Kanawha Lookout** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. It is located just east of Vault 76. [Pub 1] 

“Beware of Sickleman! At least, that’s what the graffiti in the crawl space of the cabin on the grounds of this lookout tower states. Crawl up through the hole here to explore the cabin interior. Then check the tower and nearby outhouse for a key (atop an outhouse roof) to the safe atop the tower.”— Atlas of Appalachia

A number of Super Mutants and Floaters inhabit this fire watchtower. Directly below it are a Cooking Station and an Explosives Crate surrounded by Meat Bags put together by the Super Mutants. A Survey Marker is found nearby, as is a Portable Toilet, which has a Safe Key laying on top of it. The room atop the tower contains more Meat Bags and gore, a Safe that can be unlocked only with the key, as well as a note.

A derelict wooden cabin is found to the south, nearby the tower. It has a Water Pump, as well as a Weapons Workbench on the veranda overlooking the cliff. Underneath the veranda is an opening leading into a crawlspace that has a level 0-locked Safe and four beheaded Skeletons underneath graffiti that reads "Sickleman is here." The skulls of these headless Skeletons can be found in the nearby Hot Tub. The cabin's interior can be accessed from either the red door on the veranda or the hole in the floor in the crawlspace, next to the Safe.

- Responder's Note - Note, on top of the Safe inside the tower.
- Safe Key - Found on top of a port-a-potty to the west. Opens the Safe inside the tower.
- Two potential recipes:
 - South of the tower, in the cabin.
 - South of the tower, in the shack next to the cabin.

Climbing to the top of the lookout lets the player character survey the area, which can unlock the following locations:

The North Kanawha Lookout appears in *Fallout 76*.

- Before the *Wastelanders* update, the graffiti in the ruined cabin read "Sickleman*was* here." [Dev 1] 
- The Sickleman graffiti was implemented by lead artist Nathan Purkeypile and is based on a series of stories about monsters and ghosts that he wrote in fifth grade. [Dev 2]
